usedFor: Signaturit holds documents for e-signature, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command after “Document Completed” through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document Completed” in Signaturit, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A signed document starts a command on your own computers, so local steps follow.

watchOut: “Document Opened” can fire more than once per document, so it can run “Trigger Command” repeatedly.
